title: IBM Turbonomic kubeturbo agent 8.16.0 through 8.21.2 does not validate or improperly validates TLS certificate…
description: IBM Turbonomic kubeturbo agent versions 8.16.0 through 8.21.2 have a vulnerability where TLS certificates are not properly validated. This flaw could allow an attacker to intercept sensitive information via man-in-the-middle attacks.
